implementation.cause: The DEX resolver reaches builtin Activity outside DEX, then finds an abstract interface declaration. Portable dispatch previously treated any DEX declaration as a class implementation, suppressing the real inherited framework provider.
implementation.validation: Portable DEX calls validate receiver assignability before instance dispatch. Missing DEX constructors cannot be replaced by framework success. A non-static invocation cannot execute a static DEX target.
implementation.policy: Concrete, native and abstract DEX class methods retain class precedence. When only an interface candidate or no DEX method remains, the receiver-backed framework implementation is tried before selecting an interface method/default/abstract error.
